inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Detection for Sudo Chroot Privilege Escalation (CVE-2025-32463)

properties.description: This detection identifies potential exploitation attempts of the Sudo Chroot Privilege Escalation vulnerability (CVE-2025-32463).
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Detection for Sudo Chroot Privilege Escalation (CVE-2025-32463)
properties.query:
let LookBack = 1h;
let SudoExploit =
DeviceFileEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookBack)
| where ActionType == "FileModified"
| where FileName has "nsswitch.conf" and FolderPath has "/etc"
| project DeviceName;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookBack)
| where ProcessCommandLine startswith "sudo -R" or InitiatingProcessCommandLine startswith "sudo -R"
| where DeviceName has_any(SudoExploit)
